title: RAW_UNSCREENED: chor-chol-daiin als Mengen- oder Gradeintrag
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: identical chor chol daiin occurs at f21r.12 and f32v.10; the repeated template can encode a quality degree or an ingredient amount, with later axis consequences.

design.scope_description: Exact repeated triples in GDT809 plus bounded value-field controls in GDT764 and historical degree/amount cache.
design.mechanism: The whole triple is a recurring field template whose terminal daiin axis is either descriptive degree or recipe amount.
design.unit: f21r.12 and f32v.10 chor chol daiin, plus ctho/cthaiin daiin controls.
design.contrast: Descriptive quality-degree record versus prescriptive quantity record.
design.prediction: Degree reading predicts the same chol quality axis can take values in parallel descriptor frames; amount reading predicts the head names a material and the value participates in ingredient/portion accounting.
concrete_observations: GDT809 reports exact chor chol daiin at f21r.12 and f32v.10 in all readers.
f32v.9 has chocthy daiin cthaiin daiin, a neighboring two-field value pattern.
linked_consequences: Degree interpretation must preserve the repeated modifier order and avoid creating new material quantities.
Amount interpretation must bind each value to a written material head and a compatible record scope.
design.nearest_rival: The same complete template is a quality/degree field rather than a quantity field.
design.distinguishing_observation: Use only repeated target-independent axis behavior: a selected axis must recur in both triple loci and in a nonidentical control, with no free gloss added to chol or daiin.
assumption_costs: one terminal value axis is hypothesized
historical degree/amount analogues are only priors
design.strongest_likely_failure: GDT686/GDT764 already show local axis freedom; repeated template alone may not distinguish degree from amount.
